cohort: Children 0-23 months of age in Afghanistan, Bangladesh, India, Nepal, and Pakistan.
finding: EIBF, APF, and EBF increased in Bangladesh, India, and Nepal from 1990 to 2016 but showed declines in Afghanistan and recently in Pakistan; CBF remained fairly constant across the region.
mod_finding: Caesarian delivery was a significant predictor of suboptimal breastfeeding practices.
birth_weight: small size at birth (exact weights not specified)
